enchantments.tooltip: Deception +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to hit and +18 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +21 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Accuracy +23: Passive: +23 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Quality Accuracy +5: Passive: +5 Quality bonus to attack rolls
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
